Title: Document 7
Content: Source: Varro, Roman scholar, On Landed Estates, `text(first century B.C.E.)`

It was not without reason that those great men, our ancestors, put the Romans who lived in the country ahead of those who lived in the city. Our ancestors thought that those who settled in town were lazier than those who dwelt in the country.

These `text(days)`, practically all the heads of families have sneaked within the walls of the city, abandoning the sickle and the plow, and would rather busy their hands in the theater and in the circus than in the grain fields and the vineyards. We hire men to bring from Africa and Sardinia the slave-produced grain with which to fill our stomachs.
